outcome_statement: In a fresh short exchange, the learner can ask and answer direct personal-detail questions without a dialogue model.

exact_introductions.label: Present be: questions and short answers
exact_introductions.bounded_scope: Ask and answer direct questions about identity, state, description, and location.
exact_introductions.later_boundary: Embedded questions and question tags wait for later levels.

exact_introductions.label: High-utility information question frames
exact_introductions.bounded_scope: Obtain the identity, place, time, price, or quantity needed in a predictable exchange.
exact_introductions.later_boundary: Why, which, whose, how long, and open-ended follow-up systems wait.

exact_introductions.label: familiar adult jobs
exact_introductions.bounded_scope: Use a fitting job from the set or the learner's personally required job label.

exact_introductions.label: personal-information question frames
exact_introductions.bounded_scope: Select and ask the frame that retrieves the missing detail in a fresh information gap.

exact_introductions.label: contact-detail and spelling repair
exact_introductions.bounded_scope: Use one fitting repair frame when a fresh name or number is unclear.

exact_introductions.label: Letter names and spelling-sound verification
exact_introductions.bounded_scope: Recognise the English letter name and check a heard model or IPA for irregular high-value spellings rather than applying one fixed letter-sound rule.
exact_introductions.later_boundary: No full phonics or spelling-to-sound system is promised at A1.

exact_introductions.label: Hear and highlight the key detail
exact_introductions.bounded_scope: Notice and imitate prominence on the name, number, price, time, destination, item, or need that carries the contrast.
exact_introductions.later_boundary: Natural English rhythm, reductions, and native-like timing are not A1 mastery demands.

exact_introductions.label: Repeat, slow, or spell a key item to repair
exact_introductions.bounded_scope: Notice a listener signal and repair the key item through slower repetition, contrast, or spelling.
exact_introductions.later_boundary: Repair success matters more than producing the reference model on the first attempt.

exact_recycles.label: Recognisable social and question contours
exact_recycles.bounded_scope: Use or imitate a recognisable contour for a greeting, wh-question, yes/no check, and polite response while accepting variety.
exact_recycles.later_boundary: No single universal rise/fall pattern or emotion-reading claim is imposed.

mastery.fresh_task: Ask for name, origin, residence, and job; answer the partner's changed questions.
mastery.support_boundary: Detail icons only; no full question or answer frames.
mastery.critical_meaning: Each question retrieves its intended detail and unclear key information is repaired.
